items.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy Just Lost Its MSCI Index Spot as Bitcoin Plunges. Is MSTR Stock a Sell?
items.summary: With an index provider cutting it loose and bitcoin sitting below its purchase price, Saylor's funding machine faces its toughest test yet. A cash cushion buys time, but one signal could decide whether patience pays off.

items.title: Strategy Is Down 27% in 2026: Dead Money, or Due for a Bounce?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStrategy stock is down 27% in 2026, and the whole loss came after it finished September about where it started the year. MSCI’s decision to drop Strategy from its indexes and the cash going into STRC buybacks both make it harder to sell stock at the premium its bitcoin buying needs.

items.title: Strategy Stocks Fall 3.64% as Bitcoin Breaks $70,000 Ahead of MSCI Exit
items.summary: Bitcoin now sits about 8% below Strategy's average cost, two weeks before MSCI drops the shares from its indexes.
